research_question: Does medium-horizon cross-sectional reversal exist across liquid Binance USDT perpetuals after costs?
hypothesis: Crypto assets with the worst trailing one-month returns outperform prior winners over the next month, consistent with overreaction reversal beyond the short momentum horizon.
economic_mechanism: Speculative overreaction and fast mean reversion in crypto can cause short-horizon momentum to switch into medium-horizon reversal.

signal.rebalance: first UTC day of each month at 00:00 signal; execute next hourly open
signal.weighting: equal weight within each leg; 0.5 gross long + 0.5 gross short
signal.position_rule: long worst trailing-return quartile; short best quartile

execution.funding: not modeled separately; assess extra carry drag as execution uncertainty

validation.primary_metric: net OOS annualized Sharpe from daily portfolio equity returns
diagnostics: monthly cross-sectional rank IC expected negative
winner-loser spread expected negative before sign inversion

kill_criteria.factor_gate: canonical mean rank IC >= 0 or unstable reversal sign
kill_criteria.strategy_gate: net OOS Sharpe <= 0.5 or <=0 under 2x costs
kill_criteria.concentration_gate: Sharpe collapses below 0.5 after strongest asset removal
